explanation: The execution contains a fault because the stipulated qualifying demand record n06-r06 was silently omitted before the downstream job. The top-level corpus includes n06-r06 with demand_score 5, so it qualifies under the demand_score >= 3 rule and should have been preserved. Job 2 received only seven needs and evidence_sources, already missing n06-r06, so the fault originates upstream. The supplied upstream normalize function localizes the cause: its allowed_record_ids list contains n06-r09 instead of n06-r06, causing n06-r06 to be filtered out.
cited_evidence: top_level_input.corpus contains record_id n06-r06 with demand_score 5, need 'compare selected and complete runtime evidence', source_id s06, source_weight 3.

job_2 input needs and evidence_sources omit n06-r06, showing the missing record was not handed downstream.
